1.0.3.en: Fixed: virtual switch groups no longer appear as selectable devices when creating a new group

1.0.5.en: Added desync log in app settings (Configure) to diagnose sync issues over time

1.0.6.en: Desync log page in app settings (Configure) — view, copy and clear sync failure history

1.0.7.en: Sync log now shows who triggered each action, timing per device, and filter All / Errors

1.0.8.en: Auto-Heal: when a device fails to sync, the app automatically retries — enable in group settings (20s cooldown per device)

1.0.9.en: Added Flow cards for sync failures, group status and Force Resync. Group cards now show each linked switch's live ON/OFF status by default, configurable in app settings; when disabled, only device names are shown. Sync diagnostics are clearer, and repeated failures are logged once with their recovery.

1.0.10.en: Fixed the titles of the group sync status and Force Resync Flow cards.

1.1.1.en: Added the Switch Master driver for scene-style control (1 master + 2 to 9 slaves). Linked Switch groups can now have an optional Primary device that is controlled first, while the rest follow with a small stagger to keep your Zigbee network calm. Commands are debounced to avoid duplicate propagations, and the shared sync log only records failures and recoveries. Device conflict rules are now clearer: a Linked Switch member can also be a controlled switch in a Switch Master, but not both members of the same Linked Switch group. The log page refreshes automatically when new entries arrive, and on-demand re-subscription heals silent listener failures.

1.1.2.en: Group health checks now run every 10 minutes (previously a constant 30-second poll) plus right after any failed sync, keeping detection responsive with far less background overhead. Devices deleted from Homey are now detected in both Linked Switch and Switch Master groups: Switch Master slaves and Linked Switch members are automatically removed, while a missing Switch Master device is flagged for repair. Detection requires two failures at least 5 minutes apart to avoid false removals from a brief network hiccup. Each group also logs a one-line status summary on startup, visible in diagnostic reports even with debug logging off.

1.1.3.en: Fixed a race condition where rapid consecutive toggles could interleave and corrupt sync state — state-mutating operations are now serialized per group. Debug logging is now a toggle on the app's Configure page instead of a code setting, and the Switch Master driver is now fully translated.

1.1.4.en: Fixed Repair silently re-saving a device that no longer exists in Homey (it could never be unchecked in the form), which kept a group stuck on "missing devices" even after repairing it with the replacement.
